caption:
Anthropic revealed in its IPO filing that its internal AI usage now costs more at customer rates than its monthly employee payroll. Even wilder, Claude wrote over 90% of their new code in September. 🤖

Tech companies are shifting fast. Would you trust AI to do 90% of your daily work?

Source: Business Insider

#anthropic #claudeai #techtrends #futureofwork #siliconvalley

post.news: Anthropic says the AI used internally by its staff is now worth more at retail prices than their monthly salaries.
post.take: At this point the humans at the office are just emotional support pets for Claude.
post.insight: Tech companies are driving product growth through AI consumption instead of expanding headcount.
